title: Decision-Aware Predictions for Right-Hand Side Parameters in Linear Programs
summary: This paper studies an integrated learning and optimization problem in which a prediction model estimates the right-hand-side parameters of a linear program (LP) using a contextual vector. Considering that such a prediction alters the feasible region of the LP, we aim to estimate the constraint set to contain the optimal solution of the underlying LP, given by the true right-hand side parameters.
